hypothesis: Grafting the brainstorm-then-select in-context topology (exp001) onto the champion LoRA adapter (v2a_e1) should beat either ingredient alone, because the adapter's learned question style combined with the multi-stage generation/selection logic should compound their individual gains.
technique: A two-FM-call brainstorm-then-select pipeline (first call drafts candidate questions, second call selects/phrases the final set) where both model calls run through the LoRA adapter v2a_e1 instead of the stock base model — a systematic all-inference-topology × best-LoRA matrix sweep entry.
result: Scored 0.320 on the full-30 greedy eval — a clear improvement over the raw exp001 in-context baseline (0.235) but well below the champion exp056 (0.440). The hypothesis was falsified: the brainstormSelect topology does not compound well with the LoRA adapter at this quality level. Discarded.
